trust_decision.summary: Untrusted PostScript in embedded Type 1 font programs (and the shared PS operator interpreter) decides allocation size, loop count and name-resolution recursion depth; the bound is decided in PSOperator.array/opFor and Type1FontProgram.toExecute.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names Type 1 font programs; processObject/toExecute is the Type 1 PostScript execution loop that dispatches into PSOperator.

fix_sites.entry_point: Type1FontProgram.parseFont() on an embedded FontFile (via PDType1Font font program parsing); also PDType4Function.getResult for Type 4 functions
Type1FontProgram.parseFont(); CMapParser.parse() and PDType4Function.getResult also dispatch PSOperator.execute

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/main/java/org/verapdf/parser/postscript/PSOperator.java:576-603 (shared interpreter in a different package from the Type 1 font parser; also reached by src/main/java/org/verapdf/pd/function/PDType4Function.java:126-138)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The PS operator interpreter is generic infrastructure shared with Type 4 functions and CMaps, so a solver could argue that the 'Type 1 font' report only needs a guard in Type1FontProgram.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A 'for' loop whose increment direction yields zero iterations (or increment 0) must be a no-op with a warning, not abort parsing of the font; the second fix commit relaxes the first commit's throw to a warning.

O6_input_shapes: array operator with huge positive size
array size given as a long outside int range (Long comparison before intValue)
for loop with huge iteration count (positive increment)
for loop with zero or wrong-direction increment (zero-trip loop)
self-referencing userDict name chain in Type 1 toExecute (recursion depth)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: copy operator duplicates n stack entries with no cap on n or stack size, so stack growth is unbounded when repeated
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: copy is bounded by the current stack size, so it looks like linear stack manipulation rather than an allocation sink

O8_uncovered_routes.route: nested for loops: each loop is capped at 10,000 iterations but there is no global budget, so loops inside procedures multiply
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: each individual loop already respects the published per-loop cap

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PSOperator default branch resolves user-defined names through userDict and executes them with no depth limit (the depth guard exists only in Type1FontProgram.toExecute)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the published recursion guard is in the Type 1 parser and the default branch looks like plain name lookup; whether a userDict value can be an executable operator here is unverified
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package from Type1FontProgram depth guard

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CMap-side name-resolution loop like Type1FontProgram.toExecute without a depth bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CMapParser extends the same PSParser and executes PS objects against a userDict; a maintainer could mirror the Type 1 dispatch there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: recursiveProcedure nesting depth taken from the input without a bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Type 4 procedure nesting is parsed recursively from untrusted function streams in a different package from the font code.

O9_family: CWE-1325 improperly controlled sequential memory allocation / uncontrolled resource consumption in an embedded PostScript interpreter

O10_build.project_tests: src/test/java/org/verapdf/pd/function/PDType4FunctionTest.java and src/test/java/org/verapdf/pd/font/cmap/CMapTest.java exercise the shared PS interpreter; there are no Type 1 font program or PSOperator tests, and the fix adds none.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Throw on any non-positive or wrong-direction 'for' increment (as commit 73d6ec0 did), which aborts parsing of legitimate fonts with zero-trip loops.
